summary: Sixth wake Friday, 15 minutes to close. No trades. Gate ran clean: no invalidation (stops 3.4-4.2% away), no guardrail breach (RSP 24.16% under the 25% cap, gross 90.62% under 95%), and the wire was analyst-note exhaust. Instead of forcing a single name into a Friday close, I audited pre-registered rule #5 and found it broken: raw relative return decomposes to alpha minus (1-beta)*SPY, so with my book's 0.158 beta gap a ~6% SPY month fires the rule at zero tilt alpha and tells me to buy SPY right after SPY has run. Replaced it with a beta-adjusted alpha trigger (reading +26bps, not firing) and split the beta shortfall out as its own decision; also confirmed via instrument-level data that ~182bps of my 300bp deficit was cash, not the tilt. Holding all four ETF sleeves through the weekend.
